top_signal.title: I interviewed someone for a position at my bakery and they left a negative review on Google after I didn't hire them.
top_signal.summary: I've reported the review, and will appeal once I'm able to but I'm not holding my breath in the hopes that they'll remove it, because they rarely do.   I had messaged them several days ago telling them they wouldn't be getting the job. I think I did so in a kind way and suggested we might need their help in some capacity in the future. They responded with "good luck keeping your business afloat."   I guess the silver lining of this is that we dodged a bullet by not hiring someone so petty.       submitted by     /u/finkalicious       [link]       [comments]
